name: Bourbo
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR (30%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), COCOA SOLDS (1.8%). MILK SOLIDS. MAIZE STARCH, RAISING AGENTS [INS 503 (ii), INS 500 (ii)], EMULSIFIER (INS 322), IODISED SAL NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHOCOLATE, VANILLA), NATURAL COLOUR (INS 150a, INS 150d). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOY. MAY CONTAINS SULPHITE & NUTS.
